articles.mainIdea: Remembering Bob Weir, a Pioneering Member of the Grateful Dead
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Remembering Bob Weir, a Pioneering Member of the Grateful Dead. The rhythm guitarist and singer brought sophisticated playing, a breezy voice and a grand sonic vision to the band, whose legacy he celebrated in various groups for decades after its dissolution.
